A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same MAGMA research. Their main texts, equations, algorithms, figures, tables, and Appendices A–F are readable and support reliable matching across revisions.

before.justification: v1 reports original MAGMA accuracy, efficiency, and ablation results on LoCoMo and LongMemEval, alongside appendix case studies and metric analyses.

after.justification: v2 retains those empirical results and additionally reports single-graph ablation results on LoCoMo in Table 5.

M1.justification: Section 3 and Algorithms 1–3 retain the four-graph representation, adaptive retrieval, and dual-stream memory evolution. The new appendix walkthrough explains the existing procedure; the proposed full method is unchanged.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate LoCoMo and LongMemEval with the same task categories. The new ablation uses existing LoCoMo coverage, and the appendix walkthrough reuses the existing Melanie cases.

E2.justification: v2 Table 5 introduces Causal Only, Temporal Only, and Entity Only as internal comparison variants against Full MAGMA. The external comparator sets in the benchmark, efficiency, and appendix comparisons remain unchanged.

E3.justification: The added experiment introduces single-graph control conditions alongside the existing component-removal controls. Previously reported backbone models, metrics, dataset counts, prompts, and baseline settings remain unchanged.

E4.justification: Section 4.5 adds a single-graph ablation testing whether individual relational views suffice, complementing the retained leave-one-component-out analysis. Existing case studies and seven metric-failure examples are retained; the new walkthrough adds explanation rather than new case evidence.

E5.justification: Both versions report point estimates without repeated-run counts, seeds, confidence intervals, or significance tests. The new ablation follows the same reporting practice.

E6.justification: v2 Table 5 adds category scores and overall scores of 0.590 for Causal Only, 0.577 for Temporal Only, and 0.531 for Entity Only, alongside the retained Full MAGMA score of 0.700. Existing benchmark, efficiency, ablation, and appendix results are unchanged.

T1.justification: The graph definitions and mathematical formulations in Equations 1–8 are unchanged. No new assumptions, derivations, theorems, or proofs appear; removing the unresolved equation cross-reference in the hyperparameter table is presentational.

C1.justification: The abstract's scientific claims, the four introduction contributions, and the conclusion retain the same scope concerning relational memory, adaptive retrieval, memory evolution, reasoning performance, and efficiency.

C2.justification: The expanded ablation discussion attributes causal-only performance to logical filtering and distractor robustness, and entity-only weakness to missing temporal awareness and logical filtering. These interpretations extend the component analysis; the substantive limitations in Section 6 remain unchanged.

D1.justification: The printed code repository identifier changes from MAMGA to MAGMA, and the link is also added to the abstract. Both versions already claim open-source code. Implementation descriptions, hyperparameters, prompts, and baseline configuration details are retained.

R1.justification: v2 adds references to Anatomy of Agentic Memory, Hippocampus, Self-Correcting RAG, and FineEdit, with limited additions to Appendix A and a supporting citation in Section 6. MAGMA's central positioning remains unchanged.

P1.justification: v2 expands Section 4.5, inserts an explanatory walkthrough as Appendix E.1, and renumbers the existing detailed analysis to E.2. It also adds an acknowledgment, expands affiliations, identifies the corresponding author, and makes small terminology and cross-reference edits.

P2.justification: v2 adds the full-width single-graph ablation Table 5 and relocates existing tables during reflow. v1 Tables 5–9 correspond to v2 Tables 6–10, with the lexical benchmark table moving to a separate page. Figures 1–3 retain their designs and content.

improvement.justification: The single-graph ablation adds useful evidence about relational complementarity beyond v1's component-removal tests, while Appendix E.1 makes the existing pipeline easier to understand. These provide modest gains in empirical support and clarity; the principal method and benchmark findings remain unchanged.
